observation: Heading outline: the original has no h1 or h2. Its outline starts at h4 for the promo cards and then goes to h3 for state names, with 17 h5s. The AI-built page has one h1 ('New heights, together.'), five h2s, eight h3s, fifteen h4s for gym names and three h5s for footer labels.

Semantic landmarks: the original has 1 header, 2 navs, 5 sections and 15 articles (one per location). It has no main and no aria attributes, and lang is empty. The AI-built page has 1 header, 1 nav, 1 main, 4 sections and 0 articles. Its cards are divs, it has 2 aria attributes and lang='en'.
Both pages put a raster PNG brand logo at the left of a white header. The original's logo is 300x64; the AI-built page's is 205x44.
The original repeats a very large logo (817x176) mid-page above the mission statement. The AI-built page uses the logo only in the header.

Header right side: the original has underlined utility links (Gift Cards, Contact Us), a 'Find a Location' state select and a search input. The AI-built header holds the horizontal nav of 7 links on the right instead.

Main nav placement: the original puts 7 white links, divided by pipes, in a separate full-width solid blue bar (rgb(1,96,153)) below the header. The AI-built page puts 7 plain navy links inline in the white header bar.

Both main navs are flat lists of seven items with no dropdowns, and both include a Covid-19 item. The original's items are Options to Climb, Locations, Covid-19 Updates, About, Franchising, Contact and Careers. The AI-built page's are Options to Climb, Locations, Covid-19, About, Franchising, Contact and Gift Cards.

Hero: the original has a full-photo carousel (1310x442) of a climbing wall, with no headline or CTA, two carousel dots and a hidden second slide. The AI-built hero is a navy band split into two columns: a white 51.2px h1, a paragraph and two buttons on the left, and a rounded, shadowed photo on the right.
The AI-built hero has a paired CTA: an orange filled 'Find a gym' pill and an outlined white 'Buy a gift card' pill. The original hero has no CTA.

Both pages have a four-column 'options' row with Gift Cards, Waivers, Covid visiting and Franchising. The original shows each as a 305x178 photo, a bold blue h4, a gray rule and a paragraph, with no card border. The AI-built page uses bordered white cards (250x344) with an h3, a paragraph and an underlined text link, and no photos.

Bottom edges in the four-up options row: in the original, uneven text lengths leave the column bottoms misaligned. In the AI-built page the cards are equal height, but links sit at different y values, and the 'Visiting during Covid-19' h3 wraps at the hyphen.
Font: the original uses the Roboto web font (425 elements), plus FontAwesome for icons (10 elements). The AI-built page uses a single system-ui stack (185 elements) with no web font or icon font.

Body text: the original sets mid-gray rgb(99,99,99) at 16px/24px. The AI-built page sets near-black rgb(22,32,46) at 17px/27.2px, with a second, lighter gray rgb(86,98,117) for card and subtitle copy.

Heading color: the original uses brand blue rgb(1,96,153) for card headings and dark navy rgb(28,53,83) for state headings. The AI-built page uses navy rgb(29,53,87) for headings at 35.2px/700 for h2s.

Palette: the original uses white, brand blue rgb(1,96,153) (19 backgrounds), dark gray rgb(51,51,51), red accent rgb(237,31,36) and darker navy rgb(1,64,102). The AI-built page uses white, navy rgb(29,53,87), orange rgb(228,87,46), peach rgb(253,232,225) and pale blue-gray rgb(242,245,249).

Section backgrounds: the original keeps the content on white, with blue only in the nav and footer bands. The AI-built page alternates white, pale gray and navy section bands with about 64px top padding.
The original has a two-column intro block: a 'Links' sidebar of blue bold links on the left, and the large logo with a bold mission paragraph on the right. The AI-built page has no sidebar link list.

Mission/About copy: the original sets the mission statement as a bold gray paragraph under the large logo. The AI-built page puts About Us and Franchising side by side in two 510px columns with regular-weight dark text; the column tops are offset (y=2688 vs 2712), and Franchising has an orange 'Get in touch' pill.
In the AI-built page, each h2 is followed by a one-line muted gray subtitle paragraph (680px wide). The original has no h2s and no comparable subtitle pattern.

Both pages group locations by state under h3 headings in the order California, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, with cards in a three-column grid. The original separates groups with thin pale-blue rules; the AI-built page gives each h3 a short orange underline.
Location card imagery: the original cards each have a 353x253 photo or rendering with a thin dark border. The AI-built location cards have no images, only a title and text.

On both pages, location descriptions vary in length: Brick and Montclair have none, while Melville has about 7 lines. Card heights or text blocks are therefore uneven. In the AI-built page, cards in a row stretch to equal height.
Location name style: the original shows a gray 'City, ST' text name. The AI-built page shows an underlined navy h4 link, while the titles of unopened gyms are plain text.

Coming-soon marker: the original overlays a red rgb(237,31,36) 'Coming Soon!' ribbon with a notched end on the top-left of the photo (Marin, Nassau, Lehigh Valley, Philadelphia). The AI-built page uses a peach pill badge with dark-orange, uppercase, letter-spaced 'COMING SOON' text.
Image count and density: the original is image-heavy, with 26 img elements and many location photos. The AI-built page has only 2 images (the logo and the hero photo) and is text-led.
Alt text: the original's images have empty alt text, with one alt attribute missing. The AI-built page's images all have alt text (alt_missing 0), and the hero alt is descriptive.
Both pages show raster images larger than their natural size. In the original, 350px images render at 353px through a resizer. In the AI-built page, the 326x233 hero image renders at 486x233.

Border radius: the original is almost entirely square (431 at 0, 2 at 1-7px, 2 pills, none at 8-15px). The AI-built page uses 22 elements at 8-15px (cards, select, input, image) and 7 pills, with 156 square.

Primary button: the original's 'Go To My Gym' is a blue rgb(1,96,153) rectangle with 0px radius and 3px 15px 4px padding. The AI-built page's 'Find a gym' is an orange rgb(228,87,46) pill with 999px radius and 12px 22px padding.

Effects: neither page uses gradients, backdrop blur, animations or transforms. The original has 4 box shadows (including a subtle nav shadow) and 10 transitions. The AI-built page has 1 box shadow (on the hero image) and 0 transitions.

In the AI-built page, cards are separated from the background by a thin light-gray border on a white fill with no shadow. The original's location cards have no border; instead, the border sits on their photos.

Footer structure: the original has two stacked blue bands. The upper band has a newsletter signup and five white social icons; the lower, darker navy band has copyright and policy links. The AI-built footer is one navy block with three columns (Explore, Follow, Legal) under bold white h5 labels, with a divider and copyright line below.

Newsletter form: the original's sits in the blue footer band, with an envelope icon, a centered-placeholder 'e-mail' input and a check-circle icon submit. The AI-built page's is a single-row form in a pale gray section: a 945px email input and an orange pill 'Sign up' button.
Both footers show a © 2021 Gravity Vault copyright.
Layout technique: the original uses no display:grid or display:flex, relies on float/table-style layout and has 151 divs. The AI-built page uses 8 grid and 4 flex containers with 42 divs.

Content width: the original's location area spans about 1100px (x170-1270), but the hero and promo row run wider at 1310px (x65-1375). The AI-built page aligns everything to one centered column about 1060px wide (x190-1250).

Styling code: the original has 377 class uses across 140 unique classes, 31 inline style attributes, 3 stylesheets, 2 style blocks and 17 scripts. The AI-built page has 51 class uses across 18 unique classes, 2 inline styles, no external stylesheet, 1 style block and 1 script. Neither uses a utility-class pattern.

Copy tone: the original is exclamatory and community-oriented, with 19 exclamation marks and 1 emoji. The AI-built page is plain and informational, with 0 exclamation marks and 0 emoji. Both have about 560-570 words.
Both pages keep legacy Covid-19 content: a nav item ('Covid-19 Updates' / 'Covid-19') and an options card ('Visiting Us During This Time' / 'Visiting during Covid-19').
Page length: the original is 4323px tall, with the long scroll mostly location cards. The AI-built page is 3674px tall, and the Locations section (about 1610px) takes about 44% of it.

Link styling: the original varies by region. Sidebar links are blue, bold and not underlined; header utility links are underlined in gray; nav links are plain white. The AI-built page underlines links consistently (navy on light, white in the footer) and leaves only the header nav plain.
Anchor and button counts: the original has 84 anchors and 2 buttons. The AI-built page has 42 anchors and 1 button element, and its CTAs mix orange pills with underlined text links.

State selector: the original has a 'Find a Location' select with a visible small gray label and a blue chevron in the header, alongside a search input. The AI-built page has a 220x46 rounded state-filter select inside the Locations section, with a visually hidden label and no search input.

Page title and meta: the original's title is 'The Gravity Vault | Indoor Rock Climbing Gyms | NJ, NY & PA', and its meta tags include keywords, author and google-site-verification. The AI-built page's title is 'The Gravity Vault | Indoor Rock Gyms', and its meta tags are only charset, viewport and description. Neither has JSON-LD.

Both pages use generous vertical spacing. The original has about 50px gaps between rows and hairline rules between region groups. The AI-built page has about 64px of section padding and 16-20px card gaps.
Social links: the original shows five white FontAwesome social icons in the footer. The AI-built page has a text-link 'Follow' footer column with no icons.
The AI-built footer includes a credit link to the web agency ('Lform Design'). The original's judge did not mention a comparable credit.
